description: The type of full-text query to execute against a search index.

enum.name: SIMPLE_QUERY_STRING
enum.description: Default. Supports +, -, |, quotes, ~, *, () operators. Best for user-facing search boxes.

enum.name: MATCH
enum.description: Standard full-text match. Best for programmatic queries.

enum.name: MULTI_MATCH
enum.description: Matches across multiple fields with configurable boost.

enum.name: MATCH_PHRASE
enum.description: Exact phrase matching. Terms must appear in order and adjacent.

enum.name: PREFIX
enum.description: Prefix matching for autocomplete and type-ahead.

enum.name: MATCH_ALL
enum.description: Returns all documents. Used automatically when queryText is null or empty.
